name.en-US: Office of Corpus Christi (Sapientia aedificavit, early draft)
name.la: Officium Corporis Christi (Sapientia aedificavit, recensio prima)
name.pt-BR: Ofício de Corpus Christi (Sapientia aedificavit, redação primitiva)

description.en-US: The alternate (early) draft of the Office of Corpus Christi, beginning *Sapientia aedificavit sibi*. The *Sacerdos in aeternum* version (in `aquinas-office-corpus-christi`) was the one ultimately adopted by the Church.
description.la: Recensio prima Officii Corporis Christi, a verbis *Sapientia aedificavit sibi* incipiens. Recensio *Sacerdos in aeternum* in usum tandem recepta est.
description.pt-BR: A redação alternativa (primitiva) do Ofício de Corpus Christi, que começa por *Sapientia aedificavit sibi*. A versão *Sacerdos in aeternum* (em `aquinas-office-corpus-christi`) foi a que a Igreja finalmente adotou.

sources.description: Latin text from the Leonine / Marietti editions (public domain), mirrored from aquinas.cc.
Translated for Ember directly from the Latin (la) text above; the en-US translation was consulted only to confirm difficult readings, never as the base text. See translation-journal.md.
